          def _compare_and_select_under_authority(
              replica_a_retrieval_root: Path | str,
              replica_b_retrieval_root: Path | str,
              selected_package_directory: Path | str,
              comparison_output_directory: Path | str,
              *,
              repository_root: Path | str,
              projection: Mapping[str, Any], control: Mapping[str, Any],
              package_verifier: Callable[..., Mapping[str, Any]],
              dependency_sources: Mapping[str, Any],
              expected_common_launch_binding: Mapping[str, Any],
          ) -> dict[str, Any]:
              root = Path(repository_root).resolve()
              first_root, second_root, selected, comparison_directory = _strict_output_paths(
                  Path(replica_a_retrieval_root), Path(replica_b_retrieval_root),
                  Path(selected_package_directory), Path(comparison_output_directory), root,
              )
              if comparison_directory.exists():
                  return _load_completed_under_authority(
                      comparison_directory, repository_root=root,
                      projection=projection, control=control,
                      package_verifier=package_verifier,
                      dependency_sources=dependency_sources,
                      expected_common_launch_binding=expected_common_launch_binding,
                  )
              trees = (
                  _exact_replica_tree(first_root, \"replica-a\"),
                  _exact_replica_tree(second_root, \"replica-b\"),
              )
              validated = tuple(
                  _validate_replica(
                      tree, repository_root=root, projection=projection, control=control,
                      package_verifier=package_verifier,
                  )
                  for tree in trees
              )
              first, second = validated
              first_execution = first[\"receipt\"][\"execution_identity\"]
              second_execution = second[\"receipt\"][\"execution_identity\"]
              if (
                  first_execution[\"modal_task_id\"] == second_execution[\"modal_task_id\"]
                  or first_execution[\"modal_function_call_id\"]
                  == second_execution[\"modal_function_call_id\"]
                  or first_execution[\"output_volume_name\"]
                  == second_execution[\"output_volume_name\"]

          def _selected_package_inventory(directory: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
              try:
                  status = directory.lstat()
              except OSError as exc:
                  raise FrozenDispatchError("selected producer package is absent") from exc
              if stat.S_ISLNK(status.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISDIR(status.st_mode):
                  raise FrozenDispatchError(
                      "selected producer package is not a real directory"
                  )
              entries = sorted(directory.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name)
              if [item.name for item in entries] != ["arrays.npz", "manifest.json"]:
                  raise FrozenDispatchError("selected producer package inventory changed")
              output = []
              for item in entries:
                  item_status = item.lstat()
                  if stat.S_ISLNK(item_status.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISREG(item_status.st_mode):
                      raise FrozenDispatchError(
                          "selected producer package contains a non-regular file"
                      )
                  output.append({
                      "path": item.name,
                      "bytes": item_status.st_size,
                      "sha256": base.pipeline.sha256_path(item),
                  })
              return output


          def _package_reference_from_comparison(
              comparison: Mapping[str, Any], selected_directory: Path,
              *, control: Mapping[str, Any],
          ) -> dict[str, Any]:
              identity = comparison.get("package_identity")
              identity_fields = {
                  "package_sha256", "science_bundle_sha256", "graph_plan_sha256",
                  "runtime_dependency_lock_sha256", "upstream_identities",
              }
              inventory = _selected_package_inventory(selected_directory)
              if (
                  not isinstance(identity, Mapping)
                  or set(identity) != identity_fields
                  or any(
                      not base._is_sha256(identity.get(field))
                      for field in (
                          "package_sha256", "science_bundle_sha256",
                          "graph_plan_sha256", "runtime_dependency_lock_sha256",
                      )
                  )
                  or identity.get("upstream_identities") != base.FROZEN_D0052_IDENTITIES
                  or identity.get("science_bundle_sha256")
                  != base.FROZEN_D0052_IDENTITIES["science_bundle_sha256"]
                  or identity.get("graph_plan_sha256")
                  != base.FROZEN_D0052_IDENTITIES["graph_plan_sha256"]
                  or comparison.get("selected_package_file_inventory") != inventory
                  or comparison.get("selected_package_file_inventory_sha256")
                  != base.object_sha256(inventory)
              ):
                  raise FrozenDispatchError(
                      "selected producer package identity does not close"
                  )
              body = {
                  "schema_version": control["schemas"]["package_reference"],
                  "analysis_id": "D-0064",
                  "package_schema": control["package_schema"],
                  "package_sha256": identity["package_sha256"],
                  "science_bundle_sha256": identity["science_bundle_sha256"],
                  "graph_plan_sha256": identity["graph_plan_sha256"],
                  "dependency_lock_sha256": identity[
                      "runtime_dependency_lock_sha256"
                  ],
                  "remote_package_directory": control[
                      "remote_frozen_package_directory"
                  ],
                  "files": deepcopy(inventory),
                  "inventory_sha256": base.object_sha256(inventory),
                  "upstream_identities": deepcopy(base.FROZEN_D0052_IDENTITIES),
                  "immutable_image_binding": (
                      "modal_image_copy_true_before_clearance_v1"
                  ),
              }
              result = {
                  **body, "package_reference_sha256": base.object_sha256(body)
              }
              base.validate_package_reference(result)
              return result


          def _validated_completed_comparison(
              comparison_output_directory: Path,
              completed: Mapping[str, Any],
              *, expected_common_launch_binding: Mapping[str, Any],
          ) -> dict[str, Any]:
              required = {
                  "status", "attempt_directory", "selected_package_directory",
                  "reproducibility", "completion",
              }
              if not isinstance(completed, Mapping) or set(completed) != required:
                  raise FrozenDispatchError("completed producer comparison result changed")
              attempt = Path(os.path.abspath(comparison_output_directory))
              selected = attempt / "selected-package"
              if (
                  completed.get("status")
                  != "COMPLETED_TWO_PRODUCER_REPRODUCIBILITY"
                  or Path(completed.get("attempt_directory", "")).absolute() != attempt
                  or Path(completed.get("selected_package_directory", "")).absolute()
                  != selected
              ):
                  raise FrozenDispatchError("completed producer comparison path changed")
              reproducibility_path = attempt / "reproducibility.json"
              completion_path = attempt / "complete.json"
              reproducibility = _strict_producer_json(
                  reproducibility_path, "producer reproducibility record"
              )
              completion = _strict_producer_json(
                  completion_path, "producer comparison completion"
              )
              if (
                  reproducibility != dict(completed.get("reproducibility", {}))
                  or completion != dict(completed.get("completion", {}))
                  or reproducibility.get("schema_version")
                  != "d0064-two-producer-reproducibility-v1"
                  or reproducibility.get("status")
                  != "TWO_DISTINCT_PRODUCERS_BYTE_IDENTICAL"
                  or completion.get("schema_version")
                  != "d0064-two-producer-reproducibility-completion-v1"
                  or completion.get("status")
                  != "COMPLETE_TWO_PRODUCER_REPRODUCIBILITY"
                  or reproducibility.get("common_launch_binding")
                  != dict(expected_common_launch_binding)
                  or reproducibility.get("common_launch_binding_sha256")
                  != base.object_sha256(expected_common_launch_binding)
                  or completion.get("reproducibility_sha256")
                  != reproducibility.get("reproducibility_sha256")
                  or completion.get("reproducibility_file_sha256")
                  != base.pipeline.sha256_path(reproducibility_path)
                  or completion.get("selected_package_sha256")
                  != reproducibility.get("package_identity", {}).get("package_sha256")
                  or completion.get("completion_written_last") is not True
                  or reproducibility.get("package_bytes_equal") is not True
                  or reproducibility.get("truth_opened") is not False
                  or reproducibility.get("worker_dispatch_permitted_by_this_record")
                  is not False
              ):
                  raise FrozenDispatchError(
                      "completed producer comparison records do not close"
                  )
              body = dict(reproducibility)
              reproducibility_sha256 = body.pop("reproducibility_sha256", None)
              completion_body = dict(completion)
              completion_sha256 = completion_body.pop("completion_sha256", None)
              if (
                  reproducibility_sha256 != base.object_sha256(body)
                  or completion_sha256 != base.object_sha256(completion_body)
                  or completion_path.stat().st_mtime_ns
                  < reproducibility_path.stat().st_mtime_ns
              ):
                  raise FrozenDispatchError(
                      "completed producer comparison hashes do not close"
                  )
              replica_receipts = reproducibility.get("replica_receipts")
              if (
                  not isinstance(replica_receipts, list)
                  or [item.get("replica_id") for item in replica_receipts]
                  != ["replica-a", "replica-b"]
              ):
                  raise FrozenDispatchError("producer replica receipts are not exact")
              for item in replica_receipts:
                  if (
                      not isinstance(item, Mapping)
                      or set(item) != {
                          "replica_id", "execution_identity", "launch_binding",
                          "started_at_utc", "completed_at_utc", "elapsed_seconds",
                          "producer_receipt_sha256",
                          "producer_receipt_file_sha256",
                          "producer_completion_sha256",
                          "producer_completion_file_sha256",
                          "retrieval_inventory_sha256", "archived_files_sha256",
                      }
                      or any(
                          not base._is_sha256(item.get(field))
                          for field in (
                              "producer_receipt_sha256",
                              "producer_receipt_file_sha256",
                              "producer_completion_sha256",
                              "producer_completion_file_sha256",
                              "retrieval_inventory_sha256", "archived_files_sha256",
                          )
                      )
                      or not isinstance(item.get("execution_identity"), Mapping)
                      or not isinstance(item.get("launch_binding"), Mapping)
                  ):
                      raise FrozenDispatchError("producer replica receipt is malformed")
              return {
                  "attempt_directory": attempt,
                  "selected_package_directory": selected,
                  "reproducibility": reproducibility,
                  "completion": completion,
                  "reproducibility_file_sha256": base.pipeline.sha256_path(
                      reproducibility_path
                  ),
                  "completion_file_sha256": base.pipeline.sha256_path(completion_path),
              }


          def _load_completed_comparison(
              comparison_output_directory: Path,
              *, root: Path, expected_comparator_source_sha256: str,
              expected_producer_projection_file_sha256: str,
              expected_common_launch_binding: Mapping[str, Any],
              comparison_loader: Callable[..., Mapping[str, Any]] | None,
              test_only_allow_injected_comparison_loader: bool,
          ) -> dict[str, Any]:
              if comparison_loader is not None:
                  if not test_only_allow_injected_comparison_loader:
                      raise FrozenDispatchError("comparison loader injection is test-only")
                  completed = comparison_loader(
                      comparison_output_directory,
                      repository_root=root,
                      expected_producer_projection_file_sha256=(
                          expected_producer_projection_file_sha256
                      ),
                      expected_common_launch_binding=expected_common_launch_binding,
                  )
              else:
                  if test_only_allow_injected_comparison_loader:
                      raise FrozenDispatchError(
                          "test-only comparison flag has no injected loader"
                      )
                  with _fresh_comparator(
                      root, expected_comparator_source_sha256
                  ) as comparator:
                      completed = comparator.load_completed_producer_reproducibility(
                          comparison_output_directory,
                          repository_root=root,
                          expected_producer_projection_file_sha256=(
                              expected_producer_projection_file_sha256
                          ),
                          expected_common_launch_binding=(
                              expected_common_launch_binding
                          ),
                      )
              return _validated_completed_comparison(
                  comparison_output_directory, completed,
                  expected_common_launch_binding=expected_common_launch_binding,
              )

          def validate_dispatch_reference(
              reference: Mapping[str, Any], *, control: Mapping[str, Any],
          ) -> None:
              required = {
                  "schema_version", "analysis_id", "stage", "package_reference",

                  "producer_reproducibility_file_sha256",

                  "producer_archived_evidence_inventory_sha256",
                  "producer_runtime", "producer_runtime_identity_sha256",

                  "runtime_image_inventory_sha256", "runtime_repository_root",
                  "runtime_inventory_scope", "runtime_control_sha256",
                  "full_control_payload_sha256",
                  "runtime_dependency_lock_file_sha256",
                  "runtime_dependency_lock_payload_sha256", "runtime_declaration",

              control = _runtime_control(control)

                  raise FrozenDispatchError("dispatch reference fields are not exact")

  #!/usr/bin/env python3
  """Durable cumulative compute reservations for heterogeneous D-0064 stages.

  The ledger is deliberately independent of either Modal launcher.  A caller must
  durably reserve the exact workflow before making any paid call.  Reservations
  are never released: this is a conservative authorization ledger, not an invoice.
  """

  from __future__ import annotations

  from copy import deepcopy
  import hashlib
  import json
  import math
  import os
  from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
  import re
  import stat
  import tempfile
  from types import MappingProxyType
  from typing import Any, Mapping


  ANALYSIS_ID = "D-0064"
  LEDGER_SCHEMA = "d0064-heterogeneous-budget-ledger-v1"
  RESERVATION_SCHEMA = "d0064-stage-budget-reservation-v1"
  RECONCILIATION_SCHEMA = "d0064-stage-budget-reconciliation-v1"
  WRITE_CONCURRENCY = "single_o_excl_writer_required_v1"
  PRODUCER_STAGE = "d0064_mh371_two_container_package_reproducibility"
  VALIDATION_STAGE = "d0064_mh371_frozen_graph_validation"
  STAGES = (PRODUCER_STAGE, VALIDATION_STAGE)
  AUTHORIZED_CUMULATIVE_COMPUTE_USD = 100.0
  EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD = 0.858384
  EXPECTED_VALIDATION_RESERVATION_USD = 7.51086
  FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE = MappingProxyType({
      "path": (
          "analyses/D-0052-sparse-arc-bayesian-smoother/outputs/"
          "modal-budget-ledger.json"
      ),
      "file_sha256": (
          "de98a26a1f15124bb8fb6081d369bb1710e8a4990bf865ae3826967d68698c71"
      ),
      "reserved_compute_usd": 10.172808,
  })
  PRODUCER_BINDING_SCHEMA = "d0064-producer-budget-binding-v1"
  VALIDATION_BINDING_SCHEMA = "d0064-validation-budget-binding-v1"
  PRODUCER_BINDING_FIELDS = frozenset({
      "schema_version", "attempt_id", "preflight_sha256",
      "preflight_file_sha256", "clearance_sha256", "clearance_file_sha256",
      "producer_control_sha256", "producer_projection_file_sha256",
      "producer_projection_payload_sha256", "producer_image_inventory_sha256",
      "replica_ids", "output_volume_names",
  })
  VALIDATION_BINDING_FIELDS = frozenset({
      "schema_version", "attempt_id", "preflight_sha256",
      "preflight_file_sha256", "clearance_sha256", "clearance_file_sha256",
      "producer_reproducibility_sha256",
      "producer_reproducibility_file_sha256",
      "producer_comparison_completion_sha256",
      "producer_comparison_completion_file_sha256", "selected_package_sha256",
      "selected_package_inventory_sha256", "package_reference_sha256",
      "dispatch_reference_sha256", "producer_reservation_workflow_id",
      "producer_reservation_sha256",
  })
  _TOKEN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$")


  class FrozenBudgetLedgerError(RuntimeError):
      """A budget record is unsafe, stale, conflicting, or over authorization."""


  def _canonical_object_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
      try:
          return json.dumps(
              value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False,
              allow_nan=False,
          ).encode("utf-8")
      except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("value is not canonical JSON data") from exc


  def object_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
      return hashlib.sha256(_canonical_object_bytes(value)).hexdigest()


  def _canonical_file_bytes(value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes:
      try:
          return (
              json.dumps(
                  dict(value), indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False,
                  allow_nan=False,
              ) + "\n"
          ).encode("utf-8")
      except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("ledger is not canonical JSON data") from exc


  def _is_sha256(value: Any) -> bool:
      return (
          isinstance(value, str)
          and len(value) == 64
          and value == value.lower()
          and all(character in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)
      )


  def _amount(value: Any, label: str) -> float:
      if (
          type(value) not in {int, float}
          or not math.isfinite(float(value))
          or float(value) < 0.0
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(f"{label} is not finite nonnegative USD")
      return 0.0 if float(value) == 0.0 else float(value)


  def _token(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
      if not isinstance(value, str) or _TOKEN.fullmatch(value) is None:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(f"{label} is not a safe stable token")
      return value


  def _safe_relative(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
      if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or "\\" in value:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(f"{label} path is malformed")
      parsed = PurePosixPath(value)
      if (
          parsed.is_absolute()
          or parsed.as_posix() != value
          or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parsed.parts)
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(f"{label} path is not repository-relative")
      return value


  def frozen_d0052_baseline() -> dict[str, Any]:
      return deepcopy(dict(FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE))


  def baseline_from_control(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
      """Translate the existing controller pin to the ledger's explicit schema."""
      if not isinstance(record, Mapping) or set(record) != {"path", "sha256"}:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("D-0052 controller baseline pin is malformed")
      value = {
          "path": record.get("path"),
          "file_sha256": record.get("sha256"),
          "reserved_compute_usd": FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE["reserved_compute_usd"],
      }
      _validate_baseline(value)
      return value


  def _validate_baseline(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
      if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != {
          "path", "file_sha256", "reserved_compute_usd"
      }:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("D-0052 baseline fields are not exact")
      normalized = {
          "path": _safe_relative(value.get("path"), "D-0052 baseline"),
          "file_sha256": value.get("file_sha256"),
          "reserved_compute_usd": _amount(
              value.get("reserved_compute_usd"), "D-0052 baseline"
          ),
      }
      if not _is_sha256(normalized["file_sha256"]) or normalized != dict(
          FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("D-0052 baseline is not the frozen ledger")
      return normalized


  def producer_binding(**values: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
      value = {"schema_version": PRODUCER_BINDING_SCHEMA, **values}
      return _validate_binding(PRODUCER_STAGE, value, value.get("attempt_id"))


  def validation_binding(**values: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
      value = {"schema_version": VALIDATION_BINDING_SCHEMA, **values}
      return _validate_binding(VALIDATION_STAGE, value, value.get("attempt_id"))


  def _validate_binding(stage: str, value: Any, attempt_id: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
      if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("stage binding is not a mapping")
      expected = (
          PRODUCER_BINDING_FIELDS if stage == PRODUCER_STAGE
          else VALIDATION_BINDING_FIELDS if stage == VALIDATION_STAGE
          else frozenset()
      )
      schema = (
          PRODUCER_BINDING_SCHEMA if stage == PRODUCER_STAGE
          else VALIDATION_BINDING_SCHEMA
      )
      if set(value) != expected or value.get("schema_version") != schema:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("stage binding fields are not exact")
      attempt = _token(attempt_id, "attempt_id")
      if value.get("attempt_id") != attempt:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("binding attempt_id differs from reservation")
      hash_fields = expected - {
          "schema_version", "attempt_id", "replica_ids", "output_volume_names"
      }
      if any(not _is_sha256(value.get(field)) for field in hash_fields):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("stage binding contains a malformed digest")
      result = deepcopy(dict(value))
      if stage == PRODUCER_STAGE:
          if result["replica_ids"] != ["replica-a", "replica-b"]:
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("producer replica IDs are not exact")
          volumes = result["output_volume_names"]
          if (
              not isinstance(volumes, Mapping)
              or set(volumes) != {"replica-a", "replica-b"}
              or any(_TOKEN.fullmatch(item) is None for item in volumes.values()
                     if isinstance(item, str))
              or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in volumes.values())
              or len(set(volumes.values())) != 2
          ):
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                  "producer output volumes are not two distinct safe names"
              )
          result["output_volume_names"] = dict(volumes)
      return result


  def workflow_identity(stage: str, attempt_id: str, binding: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
      stage = _validate_stage(stage)
      attempt = _token(attempt_id, "attempt_id")
      checked = _validate_binding(stage, binding, attempt)
      return object_sha256({
          "stage": stage, "attempt_id": attempt, "binding": checked,
      })


  def _validate_stage(stage: Any) -> str:
      if stage not in STAGES:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("unknown D-0064 budget stage")
      return str(stage)


  def _expected_reservation(stage: str) -> float:
      return (
          EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD
          if stage == PRODUCER_STAGE else EXPECTED_VALIDATION_RESERVATION_USD
      )


  def _empty_ledger(baseline: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
      return {
          "schema_version": LEDGER_SCHEMA,
          "analysis_id": ANALYSIS_ID,
          "write_concurrency": WRITE_CONCURRENCY,
          "authorized_cumulative_compute_usd": AUTHORIZED_CUMULATIVE_COMPUTE_USD,
          "d0052_frozen_baseline": deepcopy(dict(baseline)),
          "reservation_order": [],
          "reservations": {},
          "reconciliations": {},
          "d0064_reserved_compute_usd": 0.0,
          "cumulative_reserved_compute_usd": baseline["reserved_compute_usd"],
          "d0064_reconciled_projected_compute_usd": 0.0,
          "provider_billing_summary": {
              "status": "UNAVAILABLE_OR_INCOMPLETE",
              "currency": "USD",
              "provider_billed_compute_usd": None,
              "covered_workflow_ids": [],
          },
      }


  def _seal_ledger(value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
      body = deepcopy(dict(value))
      body.pop("ledger_sha256", None)
      return {**body, "ledger_sha256": object_sha256(body)}


  def _validate_reservation_record(
      identity: str, record: Any, *, prior_d0064: float,
      reservations: Mapping[str, Any], seen_attempts: set[tuple[str, str]],
  ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], float]:
      required = {
          "schema_version", "analysis_id", "stage", "attempt_id", "workflow_id",
          "binding", "reserved_compute_usd", "d0052_baseline_reserved_compute_usd",
          "d0064_reserved_before_usd", "cumulative_reserved_after_usd",
          "reservation_sha256",
      }
      if not _is_sha256(identity) or not isinstance(record, Mapping) or set(record) != required:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("reservation record fields are not exact")
      stage = _validate_stage(record.get("stage"))
      attempt = _token(record.get("attempt_id"), "reservation attempt_id")
      binding = _validate_binding(stage, record.get("binding"), attempt)
      workflow = workflow_identity(stage, attempt, binding)
      amount = _amount(record.get("reserved_compute_usd"), "stage reservation")
      before = _amount(record.get("d0064_reserved_before_usd"), "prior reservation")
      baseline = _amount(
          record.get("d0052_baseline_reserved_compute_usd"), "baseline reservation"
      )
      after = _amount(record.get("cumulative_reserved_after_usd"), "cumulative reservation")
      body = dict(record)
      claimed = body.pop("reservation_sha256", None)
      if (
          record.get("schema_version") != RESERVATION_SCHEMA
          or record.get("analysis_id") != ANALYSIS_ID
          or record.get("workflow_id") != identity
          or workflow != identity
          or (stage, attempt) in seen_attempts
          or amount != _expected_reservation(stage)
          or baseline != FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE["reserved_compute_usd"]
          or before != prior_d0064
          or after != math.fsum((baseline, prior_d0064, amount))
          or claimed != object_sha256(body)
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("reservation record does not reclose")
      if stage == VALIDATION_STAGE:
          producer_id = binding["producer_reservation_workflow_id"]
          producer_record = reservations.get(producer_id)
          if (
              not isinstance(producer_record, Mapping)
              or producer_record.get("stage") != PRODUCER_STAGE
              or producer_record.get("reservation_sha256")
              != binding["producer_reservation_sha256"]
          ):
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                  "validation reservation lacks its exact prior producer reservation"
              )
      seen_attempts.add((stage, attempt))
      return deepcopy(dict(record)), math.fsum((prior_d0064, amount))


  def _validate_reconciliation(
      identity: str, value: Any, reservation: Mapping[str, Any]
  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
      required = {
          "schema_version", "analysis_id", "stage", "workflow_id",
          "reservation_sha256", "elapsed_container_seconds",
          "elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling", "projected_elapsed_compute_usd",
          "projection_within_reservation", "provider_billing",
          "reconciliation_sha256",
      }
      if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != required:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("reconciliation fields are not exact")
      elapsed = _amount(value.get("elapsed_container_seconds"), "elapsed seconds")
      ceiling = _amount(
          value.get("elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling"), "elapsed ceiling"
      )
      projected = _amount(
          value.get("projected_elapsed_compute_usd"), "elapsed projection"
      )
      provider = value.get("provider_billing")
      if not isinstance(provider, Mapping) or set(provider) != {
          "status", "currency", "amount_usd", "evidence"
      }:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("provider billing fields are not exact")
      status = provider.get("status")
      evidence = provider.get("evidence")
      if status == "UNAVAILABLE_NOT_REPORTED":
          provider_ok = provider.get("amount_usd") is None and evidence is None
      elif status == "AVAILABLE_PROVIDER_REPORTED":
          provider_ok = (
              type(provider.get("amount_usd")) in {int, float}
              and math.isfinite(float(provider["amount_usd"]))
              and float(provider["amount_usd"]) >= 0.0
              and isinstance(evidence, Mapping)
              and set(evidence) == {"path", "file_sha256"}
              and _safe_relative(evidence.get("path"), "provider evidence")
              == evidence.get("path")
              and _is_sha256(evidence.get("file_sha256"))
          )
      else:
          provider_ok = False
      body = dict(value)
      claimed = body.pop("reconciliation_sha256", None)
      if (
          value.get("schema_version") != RECONCILIATION_SCHEMA
          or value.get("analysis_id") != ANALYSIS_ID
          or value.get("stage") != reservation.get("stage")
          or value.get("workflow_id") != identity
          or value.get("reservation_sha256") != reservation.get("reservation_sha256")
          or elapsed > ceiling
          or projected > float(reservation["reserved_compute_usd"])
          or value.get("projection_within_reservation") is not True
          or not provider_ok
          or claimed != object_sha256(body)
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("reconciliation does not reclose")
      return deepcopy(dict(value))


  def validate_ledger(value: Any, *, d0052_baseline: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
      baseline = _validate_baseline(d0052_baseline or FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE)
      required = {
          "schema_version", "analysis_id", "write_concurrency",
          "authorized_cumulative_compute_usd", "d0052_frozen_baseline",
          "reservation_order", "reservations", "reconciliations",
          "d0064_reserved_compute_usd", "cumulative_reserved_compute_usd",
          "d0064_reconciled_projected_compute_usd", "provider_billing_summary",
          "ledger_sha256",
      }
      if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != required:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("ledger fields are not exact")
      body = deepcopy(dict(value))
      claimed = body.pop("ledger_sha256", None)
      order = value.get("reservation_order")
      reservations = value.get("reservations")
      reconciliations = value.get("reconciliations")
      if (
          value.get("schema_version") != LEDGER_SCHEMA
          or value.get("analysis_id") != ANALYSIS_ID
          or value.get("write_concurrency") != WRITE_CONCURRENCY
          or _amount(value.get("authorized_cumulative_compute_usd"), "authorization")
          != AUTHORIZED_CUMULATIVE_COMPUTE_USD
          or _validate_baseline(value.get("d0052_frozen_baseline")) != baseline
          or not isinstance(order, list)
          or len(order) != len(set(order))
          or not isinstance(reservations, Mapping)
          or set(order) != set(reservations)
          or not isinstance(reconciliations, Mapping)
          or not set(reconciliations).issubset(reservations)
          or claimed != object_sha256(body)
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("ledger envelope does not reclose")
      checked_reservations: dict[str, Any] = {}
      seen_attempts: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
      d0064_reserved = 0.0
      for identity in order:
          record, d0064_reserved = _validate_reservation_record(
              identity, reservations[identity], prior_d0064=d0064_reserved,
              reservations=checked_reservations, seen_attempts=seen_attempts,
          )
          checked_reservations[identity] = record
      checked_reconciliations = {
          identity: _validate_reconciliation(
              identity, reconciliations[identity], checked_reservations[identity]
          )
          for identity in sorted(reconciliations)
      }
      cumulative = math.fsum((baseline["reserved_compute_usd"], d0064_reserved))
      projected = math.fsum(
          float(item["projected_elapsed_compute_usd"])
          for item in checked_reconciliations.values()
      )
      covered = sorted(
          identity for identity, item in checked_reconciliations.items()
          if item["provider_billing"]["status"] == "AVAILABLE_PROVIDER_REPORTED"
      )
      complete = len(covered) == len(checked_reservations) and bool(checked_reservations)
      billed = (
          math.fsum(
              float(checked_reconciliations[item]["provider_billing"]["amount_usd"])
              for item in covered
          ) if complete else None
      )
      summary = {
          "status": (
              "AVAILABLE_COMPLETE_FOR_ALL_RESERVED_WORKFLOWS"
              if complete else "UNAVAILABLE_OR_INCOMPLETE"
          ),
          "currency": "USD",
          "provider_billed_compute_usd": billed,
          "covered_workflow_ids": covered,
      }
      if (
          _amount(value.get("d0064_reserved_compute_usd"), "D-0064 total")
          != d0064_reserved
          or _amount(value.get("cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"), "cumulative total")
          != cumulative
          or cumulative > AUTHORIZED_CUMULATIVE_COMPUTE_USD
          or _amount(
              value.get("d0064_reconciled_projected_compute_usd"),
              "reconciled projected total",
          ) != projected
          or value.get("provider_billing_summary") != summary
      ):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("ledger derived totals do not reclose")
      return deepcopy(dict(value))


  def _absolute_path(path: Path | str) -> Path:
      return Path(os.path.abspath(os.fspath(path)))


  def _require_real_directory(path: Path) -> None:
      current = Path(path.anchor)
      for part in path.parts[1:]:
          current = current / part
          try:
              status = current.lstat()
          except OSError as exc:
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                  f"ledger parent directory is absent: {current}"
              ) from exc
          if stat.S_ISLNK(status.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISDIR(status.st_mode):
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                  f"ledger parent is not a real directory: {current}"
              )


  def _fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
      flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0) | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
      descriptor = os.open(path, flags)
      try:
          os.fsync(descriptor)
      finally:
          os.close(descriptor)


  def _fsync_file(path: Path) -> None:
      descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
      try:
          os.fsync(descriptor)
      finally:
          os.close(descriptor)


  def _load_canonical(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
      try:
          status = path.lstat()
      except OSError as exc:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("budget ledger is absent") from exc
      if stat.S_ISLNK(status.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISREG(status.st_mode):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("budget ledger is not a regular nonlink file")
      payload = path.read_bytes()

      def pairs(items):
          result = {}
          for key, item in items:
              if key in result:
                  raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key}")
              result[key] = item
          return result

      try:
          value = json.loads(
              payload.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
              parse_constant=lambda token: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
                  ValueError(f"nonfinite value: {token}")
              ),
          )
      except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("budget ledger is not strict JSON") from exc
      if not isinstance(value, dict) or payload != _canonical_file_bytes(value):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("budget ledger bytes are not canonical")
      return value


  def _atomic_write(path: Path, value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
      descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=path.parent)
      temporary = Path(name)
      try:
          os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o600)
          with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
              stream.write(_canonical_file_bytes(value))
              stream.flush()
              os.fsync(stream.fileno())
          os.replace(temporary, path)
          _fsync_directory(path.parent)
      finally:
          if temporary.exists():
              temporary.unlink()


  def load_ledger(
      ledger_path: Path | str, *, d0052_baseline: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
      path = _absolute_path(ledger_path)
      _require_real_directory(path.parent)
      return validate_ledger(_load_canonical(path), d0052_baseline=d0052_baseline)


  def _with_writer_lock(path: Path):
      """Return the newly created lock path; caller removes it in ``finally``."""
      _require_real_directory(path.parent)
      if path.exists() and (path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file()):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("budget ledger target is not a regular file")
      lock = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.lock")
      try:
          descriptor = os.open(
              lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0),
              0o600,
          )
      except FileExistsError as exc:
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("budget ledger writer lock is already held") from exc
      os.close(descriptor)
      _fsync_directory(path.parent)
      return lock


  def reserve_stage(
      ledger_path: Path | str, *, stage: str, attempt_id: str,
      reservation_usd: float, binding: Mapping[str, Any],
      d0052_baseline: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
  ) -> dict[str, Any]:
      """Durably reserve one producer or validation attempt before paid work."""
      stage = _validate_stage(stage)
      attempt = _token(attempt_id, "attempt_id")
      checked_binding = _validate_binding(stage, binding, attempt)
      amount = _amount(reservation_usd, "stage reservation")
      if amount != _expected_reservation(stage):
          raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("stage reservation differs from exact ceiling")
      baseline = _validate_baseline(d0052_baseline or FROZEN_D0052_BASELINE)
      identity = workflow_identity(stage, attempt, checked_binding)
      path = _absolute_path(ledger_path)
      lock = _with_writer_lock(path)
      try:
          if path.exists():
              ledger = validate_ledger(_load_canonical(path), d0052_baseline=baseline)
          else:
              ledger = _seal_ledger(_empty_ledger(baseline))
              validate_ledger(ledger, d0052_baseline=baseline)
          reservations = deepcopy(dict(ledger["reservations"]))
          order = list(ledger["reservation_order"])
          conflicting = [
              item for item in reservations.values()
              if item["stage"] == stage and item["attempt_id"] == attempt
              and item["workflow_id"] != identity
          ]
          if conflicting:
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                  "stage attempt_id was reused with a different binding"
              )
          if identity in reservations:
              existing = reservations[identity]
              if (
                  existing["binding"] != checked_binding
                  or float(existing["reserved_compute_usd"]) != amount
              ):
                  raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                      "same workflow conflicts with its existing reservation"
                  )
              _fsync_file(path)
              _fsync_directory(path.parent)
              return {
                  "status": "ALREADY_RESERVED_IDENTICAL_WORKFLOW",
                  "workflow_id": identity,
                  "reservation": deepcopy(existing),
                  "ledger": ledger,
              }
          if stage == VALIDATION_STAGE:
              producer_id = checked_binding["producer_reservation_workflow_id"]
              producer_record = reservations.get(producer_id)
              if (
                  not isinstance(producer_record, Mapping)
                  or producer_record.get("stage") != PRODUCER_STAGE
                  or producer_record.get("reservation_sha256")
                  != checked_binding["producer_reservation_sha256"]
              ):
                  raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                      "validation reservation requires its completed producer reservation identity"
                  )
          prior = float(ledger["d0064_reserved_compute_usd"])
          cumulative = math.fsum((baseline["reserved_compute_usd"], prior, amount))
          if cumulative > AUTHORIZED_CUMULATIVE_COMPUTE_USD:
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
                  "REFUSE_LAUNCH: cumulative reservation exceeds USD 100"
              )
          body = {
              "schema_version": RESERVATION_SCHEMA,
              "analysis_id": ANALYSIS_ID,
              "stage": stage,
              "attempt_id": attempt,
              "workflow_id": identity,
              "binding": checked_binding,
              "reserved_compute_usd": amount,
              "d0052_baseline_reserved_compute_usd": baseline[
                  "reserved_compute_usd"
              ],
              "d0064_reserved_before_usd": prior,
              "cumulative_reserved_after_usd": cumulative,
          }
          reservation = {**body, "reservation_sha256": object_sha256(body)}
          reservations[identity] = reservation
          order.append(identity)
          ledger_body = deepcopy(dict(ledger))
          ledger_body.pop("ledger_sha256", None)
          ledger_body["reservations"] = reservations
          ledger_body["reservation_order"] = order
          ledger_body["d0064_reserved_compute_usd"] = math.fsum(
              float(reservations[item]["reserved_compute_usd"]) for item in order
          )
          ledger_body["cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"] = cumulative
          ledger = _seal_ledger(ledger_body)
          validate_ledger(ledger, d0052_baseline=baseline)
          _atomic_write(path, ledger)
          reloaded = load_ledger(path, d0052_baseline=baseline)
          if reloaded != ledger:
              raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("durable budget ledger changed after write")
          return {
              "status": "RESERVED_BEFORE_PAID_CALL",
              "workflow_id": identity,
              "reservation": deepcopy(reservation),
              "ledger": reloaded,
          }
      finally:
          try:
              lock.unlink()
          except FileNotFoundError:
              pass
          _fsync_directory(path.parent)


  def reconcile_stage(
      ledger_path: Path | str, *, workflow_id: str,
      elapsed_container_seconds: float, elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling: float,

  def digest(character: str) -> str:
      return character * 64


  def producer_binding(attempt: str, *, image: str = "9") -> dict:
      return budget.producer_binding(
          attempt_id=attempt,
          preflight_sha256=digest("1"),
          preflight_file_sha256=digest("2"),
          clearance_sha256=digest("3"),
          clearance_file_sha256=digest("4"),
          producer_control_sha256=digest("5"),
          producer_projection_file_sha256=digest("6"),
          producer_projection_payload_sha256=digest("7"),
          producer_image_inventory_sha256=digest(image),
          replica_ids=["replica-a", "replica-b"],
          output_volume_names={
              "replica-a": f"d0064-{attempt}-a",
              "replica-b": f"d0064-{attempt}-b",
          },
      )

              stage=budget.PRODUCER_STAGE,
              attempt_id=attempt,
              reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD,
              binding=producer_binding(attempt),
          )

      def rewrite(self, value: dict) -> None:
          self.path.write_bytes(budget._canonical_file_bytes(value))

      @staticmethod
      def reclose(value: dict) -> dict:
          body = deepcopy(value)
          body.pop("ledger_sha256", None)
          return {**body, "ledger_sha256": budget.object_sha256(body)}

      def test_frozen_baseline_adapter_is_exact(self):
          expected = budget.frozen_d0052_baseline()
          translated = budget.baseline_from_control({
              "path": expected["path"], "sha256": expected["file_sha256"]
          })
          self.assertEqual(translated, expected)
          for attack in (
              {"path": "../ledger.json", "sha256": expected["file_sha256"]},
              {"path": expected["path"], "sha256": digest("0")},
              {"path": expected["path"], "sha256": expected["file_sha256"],
               "reserved_compute_usd": 0.0},
          ):
              with self.assertRaises(budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError):
                  budget.baseline_from_control(attack)

      def test_producer_reservation_is_durable_exact_and_idempotent(self):
          first = self.reserve_producer()
          original = self.path.read_bytes()
          second = self.reserve_producer()
          self.assertEqual(first["status"], "RESERVED_BEFORE_PAID_CALL")
          self.assertEqual(
              second["status"], "ALREADY_RESERVED_IDENTICAL_WORKFLOW"
          )
          self.assertEqual(first["workflow_id"], second["workflow_id"])
          self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), original)
          ledger = budget.load_ledger(self.path)
          self.assertEqual(len(ledger["reservations"]), 1)
          self.assertEqual(
              ledger["d0064_reserved_compute_usd"],
              budget.EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD,
          )
          self.assertEqual(
              ledger["cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"], 11.031192
          )
          self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), budget._canonical_file_bytes(ledger))

      def test_workflow_identity_is_internal_and_attempt_conflict_fails(self):
          attempt = "producer-attempt-001"
          first = self.reserve_producer(attempt)
          attacked = producer_binding(attempt, image="8")
          self.assertNotEqual(
              first["workflow_id"],
              budget.workflow_identity(budget.PRODUCER_STAGE, attempt, attacked),
          )
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "attempt_id was reused"
          ):
              budget.reserve_stage(
                  self.path, stage=budget.PRODUCER_STAGE, attempt_id=attempt,
                  reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD,
                  binding=attacked,
              )
          self.assertEqual(len(budget.load_ledger(self.path)["reservations"]), 1)

      def test_validation_requires_exact_prior_producer_reservation(self):
          fake = {
              "workflow_id": digest("a"),
              "reservation": {"reservation_sha256": digest("b")},
          }
          binding = validation_binding("validation-attempt-001", fake)
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "requires its completed producer"
          ):
              budget.reserve_stage(
                  self.path, stage=budget.VALIDATION_STAGE,
                  attempt_id="validation-attempt-001",
                  reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_VALIDATION_RESERVATION_USD,
                  binding=binding,
              )
          producer = self.reserve_producer()
          attacked = validation_binding("validation-attempt-001", producer)
          attacked["producer_reservation_sha256"] = digest("0")
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "requires its completed producer"
          ):
              budget.reserve_stage(
                  self.path, stage=budget.VALIDATION_STAGE,
                  attempt_id="validation-attempt-001",
                  reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_VALIDATION_RESERVATION_USD,
                  binding=attacked,
              )
          valid = validation_binding("validation-attempt-001", producer)
          result = budget.reserve_stage(
              self.path, stage=budget.VALIDATION_STAGE,
              attempt_id="validation-attempt-001",
              reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_VALIDATION_RESERVATION_USD,
              binding=valid,
          )
          self.assertEqual(result["status"], "RESERVED_BEFORE_PAID_CALL")
          self.assertAlmostEqual(
              result["ledger"]["cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"],
              18.542052,
              places=12,
          )

      def test_exact_reservation_amount_and_numeric_attacks_fail(self):
          attempt = "producer-attempt-001"
          binding = producer_binding(attempt)
          for amount in (
              0.0, 0.1, True, False, -1.0, float("nan"), float("inf"),
          ):
              with self.subTest(amount=amount):
                  with self.assertRaises(budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError):
                      budget.reserve_stage(
                          self.path, stage=budget.PRODUCER_STAGE,
                          attempt_id=attempt,
                          reservation_usd=amount,
                          binding=binding,
                      )
          self.assertFalse(self.path.exists())

      def test_new_attempts_reserve_again_and_hard_cap_fails_closed(self):
          last = None
          for index in range(104):
              attempt = f"producer-attempt-{index:03d}"
              last = budget.reserve_stage(
                  self.path, stage=budget.PRODUCER_STAGE, attempt_id=attempt,
                  reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD,
                  binding=producer_binding(attempt),
              )
          self.assertLess(
              last["ledger"]["cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"], 100.0
          )
          attempt = "producer-attempt-104"
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "exceeds USD 100"
          ):
              budget.reserve_stage(
                  self.path, stage=budget.PRODUCER_STAGE, attempt_id=attempt,
                  reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD,
                  binding=producer_binding(attempt),
              )
          self.assertEqual(len(budget.load_ledger(self.path)["reservations"]), 104)

      def test_lock_symlink_and_noncanonical_files_fail_closed(self):
          lock = self.path.with_name(f".{self.path.name}.lock")
          lock.write_text("held", encoding="utf-8")
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "lock is already held"
          ):
              self.reserve_producer()
          lock.unlink()
          target = self.root / "elsewhere.json"
          target.write_text("do not replace", encoding="utf-8")
          os.symlink(target, self.path)
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "not a regular"
          ):
              self.reserve_producer()
          self.path.unlink()
          self.path.write_text('{"duplicate":1,"duplicate":2}\n', encoding="utf-8")
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "strict JSON"
          ):
              budget.load_ledger(self.path)
          self.path.write_text('{}', encoding="utf-8")
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "not canonical"
          ):
              budget.load_ledger(self.path)

      def test_symlinked_parent_is_rejected(self):
          real = self.root / "real"
          real.mkdir()
          linked = self.root / "linked"
          os.symlink(real, linked)
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "not a real directory"
          ):
              budget.reserve_stage(
                  linked / "ledger.json", stage=budget.PRODUCER_STAGE,
                  attempt_id="producer-attempt-001",
                  reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_PRODUCER_RESERVATION_USD,
                  binding=producer_binding("producer-attempt-001"),
              )

      def test_forged_derived_totals_and_reclosed_envelope_are_rejected(self):
          self.reserve_producer()
          ledger = budget.load_ledger(self.path)
          ledger["d0064_reserved_compute_usd"] = 0.0
          ledger["cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"] = 10.172808
          self.rewrite(self.reclose(ledger))
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "derived totals"
          ):
              budget.load_ledger(self.path)

      def test_forged_reservation_record_is_rejected_even_if_all_hashes_reclosed(self):
          result = self.reserve_producer()
          ledger = budget.load_ledger(self.path)
          record = ledger["reservations"][result["workflow_id"]]
          record["reserved_compute_usd"] = 0.0
          record["cumulative_reserved_after_usd"] = 10.172808
          body = dict(record)
          body.pop("reservation_sha256")
          record["reservation_sha256"] = budget.object_sha256(body)
          ledger["d0064_reserved_compute_usd"] = 0.0
          ledger["cumulative_reserved_compute_usd"] = 10.172808
          self.rewrite(self.reclose(ledger))
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "reservation record does not reclose"
          ):
              budget.load_ledger(self.path)

      def test_unavailable_provider_billing_remains_explicit_unknown(self):
          reserved = self.reserve_producer()
          result = budget.reconcile_stage(
              self.path, workflow_id=reserved["workflow_id"],
              elapsed_container_seconds=120.0,
              elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=7200.0,
              projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.02,
          )
          repeated = budget.reconcile_stage(
              self.path, workflow_id=reserved["workflow_id"],
              elapsed_container_seconds=120.0,
              elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=7200.0,
              projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.02,
          )
          self.assertEqual(result["status"], "RECONCILED_APPEND_ONLY")
          self.assertEqual(
              repeated["status"], "ALREADY_RECONCILED_IDENTICAL_WORKFLOW"
          )
          summary = repeated["ledger"]["provider_billing_summary"]
          self.assertEqual(summary["status"], "UNAVAILABLE_OR_INCOMPLETE")
          self.assertIsNone(summary["provider_billed_compute_usd"])
          record = repeated["reconciliation"]
          self.assertEqual(
              record["provider_billing"]["status"], "UNAVAILABLE_NOT_REPORTED"
          )
          self.assertIsNone(record["provider_billing"]["amount_usd"])

      def test_reconciliation_timeout_projection_and_append_only_guards(self):
          reserved = self.reserve_producer()
          workflow = reserved["workflow_id"]
          for elapsed, ceiling, projected in (
              (2.0, 1.0, 0.01),
              (1.0, 2.0, 1.0),
              (True, 2.0, 0.01),
              (1.0, float("nan"), 0.01),
          ):
              with self.subTest(elapsed=elapsed, ceiling=ceiling, projected=projected):
                  with self.assertRaises(budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError):
                      budget.reconcile_stage(
                          self.path, workflow_id=workflow,
                          elapsed_container_seconds=elapsed,
                          elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=ceiling,
                          projected_elapsed_compute_usd=projected,
                      )
          budget.reconcile_stage(
              self.path, workflow_id=workflow,
              elapsed_container_seconds=1.0,
              elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=2.0,
              projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.01,
          )
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(
              budget.FrozenBudgetLedgerError, "append-only"
          ):
              budget.reconcile_stage(
                  self.path, workflow_id=workflow,
                  elapsed_container_seconds=1.5,
                  elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=2.0,
                  projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.01,
              )

      def test_provider_report_requires_evidence_and_only_complete_coverage_sums(self):
          producer = self.reserve_producer()
          validation = budget.reserve_stage(
              self.path, stage=budget.VALIDATION_STAGE,
              attempt_id="validation-attempt-001",
              reservation_usd=budget.EXPECTED_VALIDATION_RESERVATION_USD,
              binding=validation_binding("validation-attempt-001", producer),
          )
          with self.assertRaisesRegex(

          ):
              budget.reconcile_stage(
                  self.path, workflow_id=producer["workflow_id"],
                  elapsed_container_seconds=1.0,
                  elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=2.0,
                  projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.01,
                  provider_billing_status="AVAILABLE_PROVIDER_REPORTED",
                  provider_billed_usd=0.009,
              )
          evidence = {"path": "billing/provider.json", "file_sha256": digest("a")}
          first = budget.reconcile_stage(
              self.path, workflow_id=producer["workflow_id"],
              elapsed_container_seconds=1.0,
              elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=2.0,
              projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.01,
              provider_billing_status="AVAILABLE_PROVIDER_REPORTED",
              provider_billed_usd=0.009, provider_billing_evidence=evidence,
          )
          self.assertIsNone(
              first["ledger"]["provider_billing_summary"]["provider_billed_compute_usd"]
          )
          second = budget.reconcile_stage(
              self.path, workflow_id=validation["workflow_id"],
              elapsed_container_seconds=2.0,
              elapsed_container_seconds_ceiling=3.0,
              projected_elapsed_compute_usd=0.02,
              provider_billing_status="AVAILABLE_PROVIDER_REPORTED",
              provider_billed_usd=0.018, provider_billing_evidence=evidence,
          )
          summary = second["ledger"]["provider_billing_summary"]
          self.assertEqual(
              summary["status"], "AVAILABLE_COMPLETE_FOR_ALL_RESERVED_WORKFLOWS"
          )
          self.assertAlmostEqual(summary["provider_billed_compute_usd"], 0.027)

      def test_atomic_write_fsyncs_file_then_replace_then_parent(self):
          events = []
          real_fsync = budget.os.fsync
          real_replace = budget.os.replace

          def fsync(descriptor):
              events.append("fsync")
              return real_fsync(descriptor)

          def replace(source, target):
              events.append("replace")
              return real_replace(source, target)

          with (
              mock.patch.object(budget.os, "fsync", side_effect=fsync),
              mock.patch.object(budget.os, "replace", side_effect=replace),
          ):
              self.reserve_producer()
          replace_index = events.index("replace")
          self.assertIn("fsync", events[:replace_index])
          self.assertIn("fsync", events[replace_index + 1:])

+def _resource_spec(stage: str, kind: str) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
+    if stage == PRODUCER_STAGE and kind == \"producer_replica\":
+        return 2.0, 24576, 3600

+        \"aggregate\": (2.0, 24576, 3600),
+    }
+    if stage == VALIDATION_STAGE and kind in validation:
+        return validation[kind]
+    raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(\"completion evidence has an unknown resource kind\")

+def _derive_resource_projection(
+    stage: str, segments: Any,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(segments, list):
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(\"completion resource segments are not a list\")

+            raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("resource segment fields are not exact")
+        segment_id = _token(item.get("segment_id"), "resource segment_id")
+        kind = item.get("kind")

+def _verified_completion_evidence(
+    *, stage: str, workflow_id: str, reservation: Mapping[str, Any],
+    completion_artifact_path: Path | str, completion_verifier: Any,
+    repository_root: Path | str,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    root = _absolute_path(repository_root)
+    _require_real_directory(root)
+    binding = reservation["binding"]
+    verifier_path = root / binding["completion_verifier_path"]
+    if (
+        not verifier_path.is_file()
+        or verifier_path.is_symlink()
+        or _sha256_path(verifier_path)
+        != binding["completion_verifier_source_sha256"]
+    ):
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("completion verifier source differs from binding")
+    code = getattr(completion_verifier, "__code__", None)
+    if (
+        code is None
+        or _absolute_path(code.co_filename) != verifier_path
+    ):
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
+            "completion verifier callable is not defined by its pinned source"
+        )
+    artifact_path = _absolute_path(completion_artifact_path)
+    _require_real_directory(artifact_path.parent)
+    artifact = _load_canonical(artifact_path, "completed stage artifact")
+    artifact_file_sha256 = _sha256_path(artifact_path)
+    try:
+        raw = completion_verifier(
+            artifact,
+            artifact_path=artifact_path,
+            stage=stage,
+            workflow_id=workflow_id,
+            reservation=deepcopy(dict(reservation)),
+        )
+    except FrozenBudgetLedgerError:
+        raise
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("completion verifier rejected artifact") from exc
+    required = {
+        "schema_version", "analysis_id", "stage", "workflow_id",
+        "completion_status", "completion_artifact_sha256",
+        "completion_artifact_file_sha256", "resource_segments",
+        "verification_sha256",
+    }
+    if not isinstance(raw, Mapping) or set(raw) != required:
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("verified completion evidence fields are not exact")
+    body = deepcopy(dict(raw))
+    claimed = body.pop("verification_sha256", None)
+    segments = raw.get("resource_segments")
+    if (
+        raw.get("schema_version") != COMPLETION_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA
+        or raw.get("analysis_id") != ANALYSIS_ID
+        or raw.get("stage") != stage
+        or raw.get("workflow_id") != workflow_id
+        or raw.get("completion_status") != "VERIFIED_COMPLETE"
+        or not _is_sha256(raw.get("completion_artifact_sha256"))
+        or raw.get("completion_artifact_file_sha256") != artifact_file_sha256
+        or not isinstance(segments, list)
+        or segments != sorted(
+            segments, key=lambda item: (
+                item.get("kind", "") if isinstance(item, Mapping) else "",
+                item.get("segment_id", "") if isinstance(item, Mapping) else "",
+            )
+        )
+        or claimed != object_sha256(body)
+    ):
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("verified completion evidence does not reclose")
+    evidence = deepcopy(dict(raw))
+    projection = _derive_resource_projection(stage, evidence["resource_segments"])
+    if projection["projected_elapsed_compute_usd"] > float(
+        reservation["reserved_compute_usd"]
+    ):
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError(
+            "derived elapsed projection exceeds reserved ceiling"
+        )
+    return evidence, projection

+def resource_task_identity_sha256(segments: Any) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(segments, list) or not segments:
+        raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("resource task identity input is empty")
+    records = []
+    seen = set()
+    for item in segments:
+        if not isinstance(item, Mapping) or not {"kind", "segment_id"}.issubset(item):
+            raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("resource task identity record is malformed")
+        record = {
+            "kind": _token(item.get("kind"), "resource task kind"),
+            "segment_id": _token(item.get("segment_id"), "resource task segment_id"),
+        }
+        key = (record["kind"], record["segment_id"])
+        if key in seen:
+            raise FrozenBudgetLedgerError("resource task identity duplicates")
+        seen.add(key)
+        records.append(record)
+    records.sort(key=lambda item: (item["kind"], item["segment_id"]))
+    return object_sha256({
+        "schema_version": "d0064-resource-task-identity-v1",
+        "tasks": records,
+    })

    +    _require_real_directory(source_path.parent)
    +    flags = os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
    +    try:
    +        descriptor = os.open(source_path, flags)
    +    except OSError as exc:

    +    try:

    +            )
    +        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:

    +    except FrozenBudgetLedgerError:
    +        os.close(descriptor)
